name: testable-terminal-mcp-spike
description: One-shot spike validating node-pty + @xterm/headless can drive real TUI agents (claude, kimi).

scripts.spike:claude: tsx src/spike.ts claude --login-shell --ready-pattern '❯\s' --prompt 'compute seven plus eight, reply with only the resulting number, no words' --expect 15 --timeout 90000
scripts.spike:kimi: tsx src/spike.ts kimi --login-shell --ready-pattern '(?:Welcome|Send /help)' --prompt 'compute seven plus eight, reply with only the resulting number, no words' --expect 15 --timeout 90000
scripts.spike:codex: tsx src/spike.ts codex --login-shell --ready-pattern '›' --settled-stability 4000 --post-ready-stability 1500 --prompt-enter-delay 500 --prompt 'compute seven plus eight, reply with only the resulting number, no words' --expect 15 --timeout 180000
